primary_title: Expression cloning of a rat B2 bradykinin receptor
decision_basis: Bradykinin activates a cloned rat BDKRB2/B2 receptor expressed in Xenopus oocytes with subtype-selective agonist responses
limitations_preserved: Preserve rat B2 receptor and Xenopus oocyte current assay; bradykinin versus des-Arg9-bradykinin selectivity and native vascular context are not generalized to SCI.

primary_title: Human AT1 receptor is a single copy gene: characterization in a stable cell line
decision_basis: Angiotensin II binds and activates recombinant human AGTR1/AT1 receptor expressed in mouse L cells, producing antagonist-blocked calcium mobilization and cAMP inhibition
limitations_preserved: Preserve human AT1 receptor and mouse L-cell expression context; rodent AT1A/AT1B paralog distinctions and vascular/SCI effects are not inferred.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4322923, Endothelin and endothelial dysfunction review
primary_title: Characterization of cloned human endothelin receptors
decision_basis: Endothelin-1 binds and activates cloned human EDNRA/ETA receptor in CHO cells, stimulating phosphatidylinositol hydrolysis
limitations_preserved: Preserve human ETA receptor and CHO binding/PI-hydrolysis context; ET-1 versus ET-3 subtype selectivity and native vascular effects are not generalized to SCI.

primary_title: Molecular cloning, sequencing, and functional expression of a cDNA encoding the human V1a vasopressin receptor
decision_basis: Arginine vasopressin binds and activates cloned human AVPR1A/V1a receptor expressed in COS-7 and CHO cells, inducing inositol phosphate production and calcium mobilization
limitations_preserved: Preserve mature arginine vasopressin and human V1a receptor context; V1a/V1b/V2 subtype distinctions and native tissue effects are not generalized to SCI.
